periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique diagonal orientation, tapering inward towards the snout at approximately a 45-degree angle relative to the horizontal facial axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Ovoid morphology with a vertical axis elongation relative to the horizontal width.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced downward tapering, where the inferior boundary extends significantly below the geometric midpoint of the patch.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Shallow U-shaped curve profile along the posterior edge of the transverse band.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Heavy thickness, covering approximately one-third of the visible torso length from the shoulder to the mid-back.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide gap between ears, roughly equivalent to 1.5 times the width of a single ear region.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smooth, convex semi-circular curvature at the superior margins.
